provenance.note: One continuous 2010-2023 series. 2010-2015 management is from Knox et al. 2016 (cal-val-data), 2016 from their medians, and 2017-2023 from the statewide monitoring product, which does not cover this parcel before 2017. Floods from 2010 to March 2017 follow the AmeriFlux WTD record, each held by 70 mm every 7 d from its onset to its drain; all flood water is soil irrigation (method 1). Tillage in every year follows Knox's disking and ring rolling before planting. Per-event source and provenance_class record which applies to each event. See tools/event_prep/README.md.
